newsitem.title: USA: Gibson Greetings up on strong Q4 figures.
newsitem.headline: Gibson Greetings up on strong Q4 figures.

text.p: Gibson Greetings Inc's share price rose 1-1/4 to 20-3/4 Thursday after the greeting card company's 1996 fourth quarter earnings of $0.39 a share beat the First Call consensus estimate of $0.29.
Gibson earned $0.29 a share in the 1995 fourth quarter, excluding results of a subsidiary sold in November 1995.
McDonald & Co analyst Jeffrey Stein said the stock rose on the earnings news.

After a preliminary look at the report, he said it appeared better cost controls helped the earnings per share figure. He declined to discuss the results further, ahead of a conference call between Gibson and analysts slated for 1100 EST/1600 GMT.
A broker familiar with the greeting card industry agreed the stock rise was due to the earnings report.
Gibson's 1996 year earnings of $1.34 a share, up from $1.00 (excluding results of the sold division) in 1995, beat the First Call estimate of $1.22.
